I am going to try and resurrect this sub with tales from my 10+ years in retail. This one's from my time as a photo lab employee!

A wild phone call appears!

Me: $drugStore Photo, how may I help you?

C: Yes, I need to get a 6x4 print for a frame. Do you produce this size?

Me: Why yes, that is our standard size. You can order easily through our web site and pick it up in an hour.

C: That's excellent, thank you!

At this point I go back to MacGyvering my Fuji 340. I haven't gotten more than one bent coathanger jammed where it doesn't belong when...

Me: $drugStore Photo, how may I help you?

C: I called you earlier about 6x4 photos. They're not available online.

Me: Ma'am, that's our standard size.

C: No I only see 4x6 size. My frame requires 6x4.

Me: sudden realization Ma'am it's the same thing. Just choose 4x6 size.

C: No you don't understand. I have a LANDSCAPE picture. I need it printed the LONG way.

Me: I uh... Tell ya what. Go ahead and send me the order as 4x6, and when I get it, I'll convert it to 6x4, ok?

C: Oh thank you SO MUCH. I really appreciate your help!

And so I saved the day, while actually doing nothing special to her order...
